title: AI neural networks
definition: Neural networks and learned representation models are artificial intelligence methods including deep learning and transformers used for inference and classification.

title: Machine learning
definition: Machine learning uses data-driven fitting to learn a model for prediction, classification, regression or decision making.

title: Electrical power transformer
definition: An electrical transformer changes alternating current voltage by electromagnetic induction; transformer coils alone are not artificial intelligence.

title: Background-only mentions
definition: A patent is not AI-related merely because AI is cited as prior art or a hypothetical future option; inspect operative claims and technical method.
